确认本次命令 / 文件操作: Approve this command or file operation
打开 {0}，连接它的窗口，并让 Codex 在当前对话中观察与操作。: Open {0} and let Codex see and control its window in this chat.
可以单次确认，也可以允许此次连接中的全部操作；换应用或断开后自动失效。: Allow once or for this connection. Access expires when you switch apps or disconnect.
仅显示前 300 项，请进入子目录查看。: Showing the first 300 items. Open a subfolder to browse more.
上传已中断，未添加到消息: Upload interrupted. The file was not added.
已上传并添加到待发送消息。: Uploaded and added to your draft.
支持多文件与拖放，单文件最多 50 MB。: Drop or select multiple files, up to 50 MB each.
上传文件后会创建对话；也可先打开已有对话。: Upload a file to start a chat, or open an existing chat first.
这里还没有文件。上传文件，或让 Codex 将结果保存到项目中。: No files yet. Upload a file or ask Codex to save results to the project.
文件保存在这台 Mac。项目中的新结果可刷新后下载。: Files are stored on this Mac. Refresh to see new project output.
滑动移光标 · 轻点点击: Swipe to move the cursor · Tap to click
触控板：滑动移光标: Trackpad: swipe to move the cursor
轻点单击，连点双击；连点后按住可拖拽。双指缩放和移动画面。: Tap to click, double-tap to double-click, or double-tap and hold to drag. Pinch to zoom and use two fingers to pan.
请返回整台 Mac 页手动解锁，再继续应用操作。: Unlock your Mac from Full desktop to resume app control.
只共享所选应用的窗口。接管后，可直接在画面里点击、拖动、滚动和输入。: Share one app window. Take control to click, drag, scroll and type in the preview.
正在共享工作台自身，会出现镜像。可在“应用与权限”中改选其他窗口。: You're sharing the workspace itself. Choose a different window in Apps and permissions to avoid mirroring.
首次画面到达后会自动显示。: The video will appear when the first frame arrives.
这台电脑属于另一段对话: This Mac is connected to another chat
把 Mac 窗口带进对话: Bring a Mac window into this chat
切回原对话继续观看，或为当前对话连接应用。: Return to the connected chat or choose an app for this chat.
选择应用后，画面会持续更新。收起面板只停止观看。: Choose an app to see its live view. Collapsing the panel pauses viewing.
全部操作已允许 · 换应用或断开后失效: All actions allowed until you switch apps or disconnect
可在授权卡中一次允许后续操作: Allow future actions from an approval card
按项目目录归类，保留原 Codex 会话与工作目录。: Grouped by project. Each Codex session keeps its working directory.
命令行、文件、网络与应用操作已允许: Shell, file, network and app operations are allowed
工作区权限，命令与应用操作按需确认: Workspace access with prompts for commands and app actions
默认开启，作用于 Skyrail 发起的任务。切换后沿用原 Codex 会话，下: Enabled by default for Skyrail tasks. Changes apply to the next task in the same Codex session.
执行中请先停止任务再切换。: Stop the current task before changing permissions.
macOS 的文件权限独立管理。请为常驻应用 Skyrail Mac 开启完全磁: macOS controls file access. Grant Full Disk Access to Skyrail Mac and restart the service to apply it.
连接已过期，请重新连接；未重放任何输入。: Connection expired. Reconnect to resume control.
系统请求了尚不支持的认证方式，请使用系统账户认证。: Unsupported authentication method. Use your Mac account.
系统账户认证失败。请重新连接后检查用户名与密码。: Mac account authentication failed. Check your username and password, then reconnect.
全桌面连接已结束。重新连接不会重放按键。: Desktop disconnected. Reconnect to resume control.
当前浏览器不支持全屏，请使用横屏或隐藏地址栏。: Full screen is unavailable in this browser. Try landscape or hide the address bar.
轻点单击，连点双击；连点后按住可拖拽。双指缩放或移动画面。: Tap to click, double-tap to double-click, or double-tap and hold to drag. Pinch to zoom and use two fingers to pan.
切换对话不会断开或锁屏。: Switch chats while keeping your desktop connected and unlocked.
滑动移动光标，轻点单击，连点双击。双指缩放画面。: Swipe to move the cursor, tap to click and double-tap to double-click. Pinch to zoom.
使用 Mac 的系统账户，不是 Skyrail 访问密码。系统有时还会显示登录画: Use your Mac account credentials. macOS may also ask you to sign in on the desktop.
共享整台 Mac 的桌面，直接点按和输入。连接时请选择共享现有桌面。: Share your full Mac desktop and interact directly. Choose to share the existing desktop when prompted.
在 Mac 上打开「系统设置 → 通用 → 共享 → 屏幕共享」，仅允许你的账户: On your Mac, open System Settings → General → Sharing → Screen Sharing. Allow your account, then refresh the status here.
无需启用“任何人请求控制”或单独设置传统 VNC 密码。: Your Mac account is sufficient for Screen Sharing authentication.
另一页面仍连接着这台 Mac，可直接切换到当前设备。: Another page is connected to this Mac. You can switch control to this device.
点按目标 · 滑动移光标: Tap targets · Swipe to move the cursor
远程键盘，输入立即发送且不保留: Remote keyboard. Input is sent immediately and discarded.
远程输入密码，解锁后继续原对话: Enter your Mac password remotely to unlock and continue the chat
查看完整桌面或处理系统登录画面: View the entire desktop or access the system login screen
历史记录和草稿保留。可重新连接原会话，或检查并结束占用它的 Codex 后台连接: Reconnect to this session or inspect the Codex connection using it. Your history and draft are saved.
目前没有检测到占用进程，可以重新连接。: No owning process found. You can reconnect.
持有该会话。结束它会断开同一进程中的: is using this session. Ending it will disconnect
，包括可能正在进行的任务和桌面端当前聊天；聊天记录保留。: , including any active tasks or chats in the desktop client. Chat history will be saved.
该进程无法由 Skyrail 结束，请在原客户端关闭连接。: Close the connection in the original client to continue.
开始一个想法，随时回来继续。: Start a chat and come back to it anytime.
这里的对话可以恢复。Codex 原始记录会保留。: You can restore these chats. Native Codex records are kept.
远程登录已过期，请重新登录: Remote sign-in expired. Sign in again.
说出任务，让 Codex 动手。: Ask Codex to do something on your Mac.
例如“打开计算器，计算 2 的 10 次方”。允许应用访问后，可查看画面或随时接: Try “Open Calculator and calculate 2 to the power of 10.” Allow app access to watch or take control.
打开本机计算器，计算 2 的 10 次方: Open Calculator on this Mac and calculate 2 to the power of 10
接着上次的思路，或开始一件新鲜事。: Pick up where you left off or start something new.
你的 Codex 和 Mac，都在这里。: Your Codex and Mac are ready.
打开应用，一起完成任务: Open an app and work through a task together
梳理一个项目的实施计划: Plan the implementation of a project
从代码和问题，走到下一步: Turn code and questions into next steps
帮我比较两种技术方案: Help me compare two technical approaches
比较方案，理清思路: Compare approaches and clarify your options
另一端正在执行，记录会自动同步: Running elsewhere. History will sync automatically.
连接本机 Codex，继续你的任务: Connect to local Codex to continue
发送任务时交给 Codex，桌面保持连接: Send to hand off control and keep the desktop connected
说说你想做什么…: What would you like to do?
添加图片，可粘贴或拖入: Add an image, paste or drop files
对话与电脑，留在你的掌握中: Your chats and computer are in your control
正在连接，请稍后再添加图片: Connecting. Try adding an image in a moment.
每条消息最多添加 20 个文件: Each message can include up to 20 attachments.
该图片已作为文件添加；直接看图请使用 PNG、JPEG、WebP 或 GIF。: Attached as a file. For direct image viewing, use PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF.
请先接管当前窗口，旧连接不能输入: Take control of the current window first
人工控制台已过期或属于另一页面: Desktop connection expired or belongs to another page
鼠标和键盘已接管 · Esc 退出: Mouse and keyboard captured · Esc to release
点击接管后，鼠标和键盘将用于操作 Mac: Take control to use your mouse and keyboard on the Mac
发送后交给 Codex，电脑画面保持连接。: Sending hands control to Codex and keeps the computer view connected.
请更新并重启 Skyrail Mac，旧版本缺少自动化权限声明。: Update and restart Skyrail Mac. The old version lacks the Automation purpose declaration.
自动化未获允许。请在 macOS 自动化中允许 Skyrail Mac 访问 C: Automation was not allowed. In macOS Automation, allow Skyrail Mac to access Codex Computer Use.
官方 Computer Use 服务未运行，请先启动 Codex 后重试。: The official Computer Use service is not running. Start Codex, then try again.
仅请求连接已安装的官方服务；请在 macOS 弹窗中决定是否允许。授权不代表已启: Only requests access to the installed official service. Choose whether to allow it in the macOS prompt. Authorization does not enable the official backend.
官方服务已接受操作连接: The official service has accepted the operation connection
官方服务未认证当前宿主。重复申请 macOS 权限无法修复此错误。: The official service has not authenticated this host. Repeating macOS permission requests cannot fix this error.
官方操作连接尚未验证；工具列表连接成功不代表可以操作。: Operation access has not been verified. Loading the tool list does not establish control.
保持高清；弱网时可能更慢。: Keep a sharp picture; may be slower on weak networks.
降低画质与帧率，优先保持响应。: Lower quality and frame rate to keep control responsive.
网络变慢立即降级，稳定后逐步恢复。: Reduce quality as the network slows; restore it gradually when stable.
已连接，但钥匙串保存失败；下次请手动输入。: Connected, but Keychain could not save the credentials. Enter them manually next time.
这是屏幕共享连接认证，与锁屏解锁不同。记住后可自动连接；锁屏密码仍在远程画面里输: This authenticates Screen Sharing, separately from unlocking the Mac. Remember it to connect automatically; enter the lock-screen password in the remote display.
记住连接凭据（本机钥匙串）: Remember connection in this Mac’s Keychain
密码不写入浏览器存储或聊天记录。: Passwords are not saved in browser storage or chat history.
已记住连接凭据，将自动验证屏幕共享。: Saved credentials will authenticate Screen Sharing automatically.
